summary: Satellite navigation (GPS) jamming near Gaerlochhead, affecting aircraft within 5 nautical miles up to 32,500ft.
text:
GNSS (GPS) SIGNAL AND RADIO FREQUENCY JAMMING (L1 AND L2). 
JAMMERS LOCATED WI 1NM RADIUS PSN 560453N 0044648W (GAERLOCHHEAD). 
ACTIVITY MAY AFFECT ACFT WI 5NM SFC TO 32,500FT AMSL OR ABOVE (ALL 
DIRECTIONS). MAY ALSO AFFECT AIRBORNE ELECTRONIC SITUATIONAL 
AWARENESS DEVICES AND UAS CONTROL. JAMMING WILL BE ACTIVE 
PERIODICALLY THROUGHOUT THE NOTIFIED PERIOD. GNSS (GPS) RECEIVERS 
MAY SUFFER INTERMITTENT OR TOTAL FAILURE OR PROVIDE INCORRECT 
POSITION INFORMATION. MAY ALSO AFFECT AIRBORNE ELECTRONIC 
SITUATIONAL AWARENESS DEVICES AND UAS CONTROL LINKS. FOR INFO / 
CEASE JAMMING 01329 414159 / 07458 670103 / 07458 673474. 
AR-2026-9674/01.
